tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches all pages of plcgateway.com (products, modules, protocols, controllers, guides) and returns the best matching pages with URL and summary. Follow up with product_info or device_support for the full text.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_demo" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
